meta.name: django-expert
meta.description: Use when building Django web applications or REST APIs with Django REST Framework. Invoke when working with settings.py, models.py, manage.py, or any Django project file. Creates Django models with proper indexes, optimizes ORM queries using select_related/prefetch_related, builds DRF serializers and viewsets, and configures JWT authentication. Trigger terms: Django, DRF, Django REST Framework, Django ORM, Django model, serializer, viewset, Python web.

copy.tagline: 构建 Django 模型、ORM 查询和 DRF 接口
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在用 Django 开发 Web 应用或 REST API
copy.tagline_en: Build Django models, ORM queries, and DRF APIs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building Django web apps or REST APIs

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会变成 Django 专家，帮你创建带索引的模型、优化 ORM 查询、构建 DRF 序列化器和视图集、配置 JWT 认证，并编写测试。
howto.when: 当你提到 Django、DRF、Django REST Framework、Django ORM、Django model、serializer、viewset、Python web 等关键词，或要求构建 Django Web 应用或 REST API 时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个 Django 文章模型，带标题和作者外键。
给这个 API 加上 JWT 认证和权限控制。
say.note: Claude 会配置 SimpleJWT 和权限类。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes a Django expert that creates models with proper indexes, optimizes ORM queries using select_related/prefetch_related, builds DRF serializers and viewsets, configures JWT authentication, and writes tests.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like Django, DRF, Django REST Framework, Django ORM, Django model, serializer, viewset, Python web, or when you ask to build a Django web app or REST API.

say_en.text: Create a Django Article model with title and author ForeignKey.
say_en.note: Claude will generate models.py with indexes and relationships.

say_en.text: Write a ViewSet for the Article API using select_related.
say_en.note: Claude will output views.py and serializers.py.

say_en.text: Add JWT authentication and permissions to this API.
say_en.note: Claude will configure SimpleJWT and permission classes.
